question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (fix_center): This image was taken from a fixed camera at the center, facing the manipulation scene.


Image 2 (ego_left): This image was captured from a wrist-mounted camera on the robot's left arm.


Image 3 (ego_right): This camera angle provides the robot's right arm perspective of the task.


All of the following images show the same robotic manipulation task.
However, one of them may have been captured at a different time.
Based on lighting, shadows, object placement, or robot motion, identify the image that appears out of temporal sync with the others.
